_comment: One entry per claim type. 'volatility_days' drives the estimated re-check date for fresh claims. 'tavily' holds the search strategy chosen for that kind of fact. Domains are plain hostnames.

model_or_api.label: Model ID / SDK / API endpoint
model_or_api.why: Vendor deprecation tables are continuously updated pages. Tavily's docs warn that time_range drops such pages, so we force a live fetch (max_age_hours=0), match the exact identifier, and prefer vendor domains.

pricing.label: Price / plan / quota
pricing.why: Pricing pages change in place and keep old publish dates, so a live fetch matters more than a date filter.

law_regulation.label: Law / regulation / tax rule
law_regulation.why: Legal changes arrive as dated publications, so a recent date window surfaces amendments that supersede older summaries.

leadership.label: Company leadership / ownership
leadership.why: Leadership changes are news events; the news topic returns dated articles and exact_match pins the person or company name.
